modal.title: Relay Tower, rebuilt
modal.text: Relay Tower, rebuilt. Our first map gets the full treatment: craggy floating islands, real lattice masts, a new dusk sky and sea of clouds.
modal.label: Signal Arena v0.4: Relay Tower, rebuilt

modal.title: The Operator’s Study
modal.text: A new game, and a new map. Shrink to mouse size in an old radio operator’s house: the study, the hallway and the library, with five ways between the bases, behind the bookcases, under the floorboards…
modal.label: Signal Arena v0.3: The Operator’s Study

modal.title: Signal Arena on the studio shelf
modal.text: Signal Arena, our capture-the-flag game, joins our games on the STUDIO shelf. Pick it to visit its page and play.
modal.label: The Junction v1.5: Signal Arena on the studio shelf

modal.title: The ride downtown, rebuilt
modal.text: A real house now: a shingle roof with a brick chimney and a TV antenna, siding, lit windows, a back door with a porch light, and a garage.
modal.label: The Path v0.5: The ride downtown, rebuilt

modal.title: The controller stays with the duel
modal.text: In The Current's duel, the controller no longer also acts on the world behind it.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04c: The controller stays with the duel

modal.title: Continue is there when you come back
modal.text: After the ending, the Continue to Beyond the Nexus button now shows on the opening screen straight away.
modal.label: The First World v0.12.3: Continue is there when you come back

modal.title: Playable on the web, up to The Current
modal.text: A concept build of Beyond the Nexus now plays in the browser, from the Nexus to The Current.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04b: Playable on the web, up to The Current

modal.title: The Current wakes, and the music gets real
modal.text: A new kind of duel on the River road, and battle music played by an orchestra.
modal.label: Beyond the Nexus Log 04: The Current wakes, and the music gets real

log.title: A steadier hand
log.text: Two fixes to the hand from a playtest: it never gets stuck after turning the camera, and things by the shore come up when you reach for them.

log.title: THE JUNCTION's floor, rebuilt
log.text: Each game on the floor now has 5 to 8 stages, each with something new, and a final boss or finale that wins it: lives and an extra life, a card before each stage and a bonus count after it.
log.label: The Path v0.4: THE JUNCTION's floor, rebuilt

log.title: Sloth wakes, and the river finds its way home
